name: Bisection Ray Tracing with Interval Inclusion
aliases: Fast and robust ray intersection with arbitrary implicits
Robust Ray Intersection with Arbitrary Implicits
definition: A robust ray-surface intersection algorithm that uses interval arithmetic (via an inclusion function) to prune intervals that cannot contain a root, followed by bisection to narrow down the interval containing the sign change of the implicit function f.
summary: Bisection Ray Tracing with Interval Inclusion is a robust ray-surface intersection algorithm that guarantees finding the nearest intersection of an implicit surface with a ray without missing fine features.
